title: Import an OpenRocket example and diff against the golden
prompt: The working directory is empty. The RocketWright CLI (`rw`) is on your PATH and its skill doc is at {skill_doc}. Import the OpenRocket example {data:example_ork}; a variant that uses the built-in generic motor curves is at {data:variant_ork} and the OpenRocket golden results for that variant are at {data:golden}. Simulate the imported rocket and report how its results differ from the OpenRocket golden.

predicates.desc: an .ork was imported, simulated, and diffed against the golden
the final design check is clean (an import may exit 1 on substitution warnings until they are accepted)
the answer reports the apogee difference
